description_en: Compresses point cloud data stored in Object Storage Service (OSS) to reduce network data transmission
description_zh: 点云压缩功能可以将OSS中的点云数据进行压缩处理。减少网络数据传输
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-compress-point-cloud-task --project-name test-project --source-uri oss://test/src/test.pcd --target-uri oss://test/tgt --compress-method octree --point-cloud-fields xyz --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCompressPointCloudTask

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the point cloud file.

The OSS URI follows the format oss://${Bucket}/${Object}, where `${Bucket}` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `${Object}` is the full path of the file including the file name extension
parameters.help_zh:
点云文件的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
parameters.name: source_uri

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the compressed output file.

The OSS URI follows the format oss://${Bucket}/${Object}, where `${Bucket}` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and `${Object}` is the full path of the file including the file name extension
parameters.help_zh:
压缩后输出文件的OSS地址。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一区域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径
parameters.name: target_uri

parameters.help_en: The point cloud file format. Only PCD format is supported. Default value: pcd
parameters.help_zh: 点云文件格式。当前只支持PCD格式，默认值为pcd
parameters.name: point_cloud_file_format

parameters.help_en:
The compression algorithm. Valid values:

octree: octree

kdtree: K-d tree
parameters.help_zh:
压缩算法名称。取值如下：

octree：八叉树

kdtree：K-d树
parameters.name: compress_method

parameters.help_en:
The PCD attribute fields that participate in compression and the compression order. After compression, data is decompressed in this order.

If you use PCL library octree compression, ["xyz"] is supported.

If you use Draco library K-d tree compression, ["xyz"] or ["xyz", "intensity"] is supported
parameters.help_zh:
参与压缩的PCD属性字段以及压缩顺序，压缩完成后以此顺序进行解压数据。

若采用PCL库Octree压缩，则支持["xyz"]

若采用Draco库Kdtree压缩，则支持["xyz"]或者["xyz", "intensity"]
parameters.name: point_cloud_fields

fields.help_en: The compression level. Valid values: 0 to 10. A greater value specifies a higher compression ratio and ensures better detail effects
fields.help_zh: 压缩级别，取值范围：0~10，值越大细节效果越好，压缩率越高
fields.name: compression_level

fields.help_en: The name of the library supported by a k-d tree. Set the value to draco. Default value: draco
fields.name: library_name

fields.help_en: The number of bits for quantization. Valid values: 0 to 31. A greater value ensures that more details are retained. A value of 0 specifies that vertex compression is not performed
fields.help_zh: 量化位数，取值范围：0~31，越大细节保留越多，0表示不做顶点压缩
fields.name: quantization_bits

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to downsample the point cloud file. Valid values:

true: The point cloud file is downsampled, and the coordinates of the points in a voxel are replaced with the coordinates of the center point of the voxel. The average color of all points in the voxel is used as the color of the voxel. In this case, the PointResolution parameter does not take effect.
false: Specific coordinates and colors in a voxel are encoded by calculating the offsets from each point to the lower-left corner of the voxel. The offsets are divided by the PointResolution value to obtain the integer coordinates. The residual of the color for each point relative to the average color of all points in the voxel is encoded
fields.help_zh:
是否对点云文件进行下采样，可选值如下：

true：对点云文件进行下采样,，以体素的中心点的坐标来代替整个体素内的点的坐标,，而颜色则以体素内所有点的颜色的均值为代表，此时PointResolution不会生效。
false： 则进行细节编码，即编码一个体素内的具体坐标与颜色，实现方式是计算体素内每个点到体素左下角的偏移量，并通过整除PointResolution来得到整数坐标，而颜色则需编码体素内每个点的颜色相对于平均值的残差
fields.name: do_voxel_grid_down_down_sampling

fields.help_en: The library name. Set the value to pcl. Default value: pcl
fields.name: library_name

fields.help_en: The minimum block size when an octree is partitioned. The minimum block size indicates the edge length of a voxel. Default value: 0.01
fields.help_zh: 划分八叉树时最小块，即voxel的边长，默认值为 0.01
fields.name: octree_resolution

fields.help_en: The point cloud resolution. This parameter determines the precision of the point coordinates during encoding. Default value: 0.01
fields.help_zh: 点云分辨率，该变量决定了点的坐标在编码时可以精确的程度，默认值为 0.01
fields.name: point_resolution

parameters.help_en: The custom information, which is returned in asynchronous message notifications to help you associate message notifications within your system. Maximum length: 2,048 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义信息，在异步消息通知中会为您返回，方便您系统内对消息通知进行关联处理。最大长度为2048字节
parameters.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The custom tags that are used to search for and filter asynchronous tasks
parameters.help_zh: 自定义标签，用于对异步任务进行搜索、过滤
parameters.name: tags

fields.help_en: The ID of the account that you use to grant permissions
fields.name: assume_role_for

fields.help_en: The RAM role that can be assumed
fields.name: role

fields.help_en:
The role type. Valid values:

user: Alibaba Cloud account.
service: Alibaba Cloud service
fields.help_zh:
角色类型，可选值如下。
user：阿里云账号。
service：阿里云服务
fields.name: role_type

fields.help_en: The authorization chains. All roles in the array must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You need to only grant other permissions, such as read and write permissions on OSS, to the last role in the array. You can grant permissions in the RAM console
fields.help_zh:
需要传递授权的链列表，数组中的所有角色都需要赋予访问 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限。
只有数组中的最后一个角色需要额外配置需要真正访问的其他权限，比如OSS的读写权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行授权操作
fields.name: chain

fields.help_en: The policy that is attached to the role specified by the ServiceRole parameter. For example, the policy allows access to OSS. This parameter is optional
fields.help_zh: ServiceRole参数的角色所需配置的权限策略，例如允许访问OSS。可选
fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The service role in the account that is used to call an IMM API operation. The role must have the `sts:AssumeRole` permission. You can configure permissions for the role in the Resource Access Management (RAM) console
fields.help_zh: 服务角色，调用IMM接口的账号需要创建的一个角色，必须包含 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，可以通过RAM控制台进行配置
fields.name: service_role

parameters.help_en:
Leave this parameter empty unless you have special requirements.

The China authorization configuration. This parameter is optional. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.help_zh:
如无特殊需求，请保持留空即可。

链式授权配置，非必填。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465340.html
parameters.name: credential_config

fields.help_en:
Use an Object Storage Service (OSS) file to receive task notifications. If you provide the URI of this file, detailed task execution information is written to the file in a JSON structure. Normally, you receive notifications through https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/161886.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27412.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29530.html. However, some tasks generate large amounts of information, such as archive previews or decompression tasks. For these tasks, provide this file to get the complete execution results.

The OSS URI format is oss\://${Bucket}/${Object}. `${Bucket}` is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project. `${Object}` is the full path of the file, including the file name extension.

<notice>

This file is not a notification method. It only serves as a medium to receive detailed task execution information. Task status is sent through standard message notifications. This file contains only the detailed execution information.

</notice>
fields.help_zh:
使用OSS文件接受任务消息通知。提供该文件地址后，任务执行的具体信息会以JSON结构写入到该文件中。一般情况下，您只需要通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/161886.html服务、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27412.html服务或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29530.html服务接受消息通知，但部分任务执行的信息会比较大（例如压缩包文件预览、解压任务），您可以通过提供该文件获取具体的任务执行结果。

OSS地址规则为oss://${Bucket}/${Object}，其中`${Bucket}`为和当前项目处于同一地域(Region)的OSS Bucket名称，`${Object}`为包含文件扩展名的文件完整路径。


<notice>该文件并不作为消息通知的方式，仅作为接受任务执行具体信息的载体。任务的状态信息会通过消息通知的方式发送，该文件仅包含任务执行的具体信息。 
</notice>
fields.name: extended_message_uri

fields.help_zh: 轻量消息队列SMQ（原 MNS）主题名称。可登录轻量消息队列SMQ（原MNS）控制台 (https://mns.console.aliyun.com/),在左侧导航栏中点击当前地域下主题列表中获取。如果需使用轻量消息队列（原 MNS）做消息通知，该参数必填
fields.name: topic_name

fields.help_en: Message notification parameters for ApsaraMQ for MNS
fields.help_zh: 轻量消息队列（原 MNS）消息通知参数
fields.name: mns

fields.help_en: The RocketMQ instance ID. Required for RocketMQ message notifications
fields.help_zh: RocketMQ实例Id。如果需使用RocketMQ做消息通知，该参数必填
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The name of the RocketMQ topic. Required for RocketMQ message notifications
fields.help_zh: RocketMQ Topic名称。如果需使用RocketMQ做消息通知，该参数必填
fields.name: topic_name
